en.headline: What's New (v2.4.5)
changes: Removed dead and unsupported code.
Optimized download performance and parallel segment processing.
Fixed UI display and layout bugs across media cards.
Added image filtering by file size.
Fixed Chrome popup sizing to remain consistent across views (#3).
Improved the extension UI in Chrome.
Fixed incorrect media detection that falsely categorized files as streams.

Meningkatkan antarmuka ekstensi di Chrome.
Memperbaiki beberapa media terdeteksi tidak benar sehingga masuk stream.
